product.title: Sierra Madre ATV Adventure from Puerto Vallarta

description.text: In Puerto Vallarta, this half-day ATV outing follows Sierra Madre mountain tracks away from crowded resorts. Drivers choose a single or two-person ATV, then pass Old Town streets and jungle rivers under a guide who handles briefing, safety gear, and souvenir photos. Morning and afternoon departures make it easier to pair the ride with a beach or bay day. A valid license is required for drivers, and the small-group format keeps the route on dirt tracks rather than a large convoy. The outing is aimed at visitors who want a guided off-road window without renting ATVs independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Puerto Vallarta, and the itinerary stays on Old Town pass-throughs and Sierra Madre trails that shape this Jalisco mountain ride.

highlights: Roar through the Sierra Madre mountains on your own ATV
No extra charges for pictures: Souvenir shots are included
Small-group tour makes for a more intimate, personalized experience
Choice of departures let you plan your day and fit more in
